comment: Official Windows Skyline engine frames captured under Wine (Electron renderer, dpr=2). Raw shared memory is BGRA on Windows and is stored here as RGBA. Coordinates are device pixels. The debug banner of the Linux comparison build is excluded via ignoreRects.

appservice-transform3d.note: Linux 3D transform fidelity differs from the official engine

appservice-overflow.note: rounded clip edges differ by at most 109/255; mismatch ratio < 0.2%

appservice-fixed-scroll.note: scroll/fixed-element edges differ by at most 26/255; mismatch ratio < 0.2%

appservice-gridview.note: official engine requires a grid builder callback; synthetic ops leave the grid empty

appservice-listview.note: official engine requires a list builder callback; synthetic ops leave the list empty
